title: Product Switch
description: Fiori grid of product tiles with grid keyboard navigation, shown in a popover from the shell bar (ui5-product-switch).

usage.summary: Let users choose another product from a grid of labeled product entries.
useWhen: Give users access to other products from the shell bar product-switch entry point.
Identify each destination with a product title and optional subtitle, icon or image.

avoidWhen.when: Navigate modules or destinations within the current product.
Inspect the signed-in user or access account settings and sign out.
